# OneAI Hub — Terms & Conditions

_Last updated: 2026-04-01_

## 1. Acceptance

By creating an account on OneAI Hub, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

## 2. Service description

OneAI Hub is a single super-admin console that orchestrates multi-provider AI access (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Perplexity). The service forwards user requests to upstream providers and renders the response back to the calling client.

## 3. Account responsibilities

- The super-admin account must have an active TOTP second factor.
- Recovery codes are shown once at setup. Store them in a password manager.
- Sessions on unrecognized devices must be revoked immediately.

## 4. Acceptable use

You may not use the service to:

1. Generate content that violates the upstream provider's usage policy.
2. Circumvent per-tier request or token limits.
3. Reverse-engineer provider routing or pricing.

## 5. Privacy

Conversation content is never accessible from this admin dashboard. Users may attach a single conversation snapshot to a support ticket; the snapshot auto-expires after 30 days.

## 6. Billing

Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period. The price and quota for each tier are visible at `/admin/config/tiers`. The super-admin may extend or revoke quota with a documented reason; every change is recorded in the audit log.

## 7. Termination

We may suspend or terminate any account that violates these terms. Suspension is reversible by the super-admin with a documented reason.

## 8. Changes to these terms

We will publish changes as a new version in this document. The current version is always identified at the top of this page. Archived versions remain accessible from the history panel.

## 9. Contact

support@oneai.app
